title: Antibody drug conjugates and methods for making thereof
abstract: ANTIBODY DRUG CONJUGATES AND METHODS FOR MAKING THEREOF ABSTRACT This application discloses microorganisms and methods of producing GNAQ/GNAl l inhibitors and methods of making antibody drug conjugates of anti PMEL17 antibodies or antigen binding fragments conjugated to a GNAQ/GNAl l inhibitor. The disclosure also relates to formulations comprising antibody drug conjugates of anti-PMEL17 antibodies or antigen binding fragments conjugated to a GNAQ/GNAl l inhibitor and methods of treating or preventing cancer using the formulations.

title: Compositions and methods for identifying and treating microparticle-associated diseases and conditions
abstract: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for identifying and treating signature MP-associated diseases and conditions in subjects. In particular, treatment methods of the invention include administering a gelsolin agent to produce a therapeutic effect against a signature MP-associated disease or condition in a subject.

title: Aptamer for recognizing and binding CD64 protein and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a nucleic acid aptamer for recognizing and combining CD64 protein and application thereof. The invention provides each aptamer and mutants thereof, and the aptamer has high affinity, no immunogenicity, can be chemically synthesized in vitro, has small molecular weight, can modify and replace different parts, has stable sequence, is easy to store, is convenient to mark (no secondary antibody to be marked), and the like. When the aptamer disclosed by the invention is used for detecting CD64 protein, the operation is simple and rapid, the affinity is strong, the synthesis cost of the aptamer is lower than that of the antibody preparation cost, the period is short, and the reproducibility is good. The invention can be used in a plurality of fields such as disease diagnosis and treatment, drug screening, molecular recognition, analysis and detection and the like.

title: Compositions and methods for capture of cellular targets of bioactive agents
abstract: The present invention provides compositions and methods for capture and identification of the cellular targets of a bioactive agent. In particular, provided herein are bioactive agents tethered to capture ligand, cellular targets (optionally tagged with a reporter), capture proteins (optionally present as capture fusions), surfaces (e.g., displaying, capture ligands, capture proteins, or capture fusions), and methods of capturing and identifying the cellular targets of a bioactive agent therewith.

title: Multispecific and multifunctional molecular and use of the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide used in cancer treatment. SOLUTION: A multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide includes: (i) a tumor targeting portion binding to cancer antigen, which is a first tumor targeting portion for example; (ii) an immunocyte engager selected from an NK-cell engager, a T-cell engager, a B-cell engager, a dendritic cell engager or a macrophage cell engager; (iii) cytokine molecules; and (iv) two or all of interstitial adjustment portions. title: Accessory positioner is used in production of environmental protection equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses an accessory positioner is used in environmental protection equipment production relates to environmental protection equipment production technical field, to the problem that traditional environmental protection equipment production can not fix a position fast with the accessory, now proposes following scheme, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the top fixedly connected with driving motor of box, driving motor's output shaft fixedly connected with screw rod, the fixed cover in outside of screw rod is equipped with first bevel gear, the outside thread bush of screw rod is equipped with the push pedal, the bottom fixedly connected with limiting plate of push pedal, the front of push pedal articulates there are two connecting rods, the top of connecting rod articulates there is the connecting block, the bottom fixedly connected with push rod of connecting block. The utility model discloses not only can be through the push rod, with the backward propelling movement of accessory fast to carry on spacingly through the limiting plate to the accessory, be close to each other through two baffles of transmission system control simultaneously, fix a position the accessory fast.

title: Intelligent trolley suspension device stable in operation
abstract: The utility model discloses a suspension device for an intelligent trolley, which runs stably, relates to the technical field of suspension devices and comprises a mounting plate and a fastening assembly; mounting a plate: a fixing frame is fixed on the lower side surface, and two corresponding connecting components are installed on the left side and the right side of the mounting plate; a fastening component: the connecting frame comprises a motor, two moving plates, clamping columns and two-way screws, wherein the motor is installed on the right side surface of the fixed frame, the two corresponding moving plates are connected to the inside of the fixed frame in a sliding mode, the two corresponding clamping columns are fixed to the side surfaces of the moving plates, threaded holes are formed in the side surfaces of the moving plates, the two-way screws are connected to the inner threads of the two threaded holes in a threaded mode and are formed by welding two threaded rods with opposite threads, and the connecting frame is fixed through a fastening assembly; wherein: the input end of the motor is electrically connected with the output end of the external control switch group, so that the occurrence of fracture can be effectively avoided.

title: Environment-friendly device applied to film blowing equipment of gold stamping film
abstract: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly device applied to film blowing equipment of a gold stamping film, which belongs to the technical field of gold stamping film blowing and comprises a supporting base, wherein the outer surfaces of one sides of two connecting plates which are towards each other are respectively connected with a storage roller and a guide roller in a rotating way, the outer surfaces of the storage roller and the guide roller are both wound with gold stamping film bodies, the top of the supporting base is provided with a limiting assembly, the limiting assembly is connected with a movable clamping assembly, a second driving motor is started in the process of winding the gold stamping film bodies and then can drive a two-way threaded rod to rotate, the two-way threaded rod drives two movable blocks to move oppositely/relatively in the rotating process, so that the clamping blocks on the two connecting blocks can be driven to clamp the gold stamping film bodies, rubber pads on the clamping blocks can prevent damage to the gold stamping film bodies, prevent the gold stamping film bodies from shifting in the winding process, and the matching of the rectangular grooves and the sliding blocks can limit the movable blocks, so that the quality of the gold stamping film in the winding process is improved.

title: Air conditioner shell transportation equipment
abstract: The invention discloses air conditioner shell conveying equipment, which relates to the field of air conditioner processing equipment and comprises a box body, wherein the box body is used for placing an air conditioner shell; the cover plate is arranged at the upper end part of the box body; a plurality of pressing pieces are laid on the lower surface of the cover plate; a fixing member; the pressing piece comprises a sleeve, an elastic rod, a spring and a pressing wheel; the outer surface of the sleeve is concavely provided with a sliding chute; the top of the elastic rod is convexly provided with a sliding block, and the sliding block is connected with the sliding groove in a sliding manner; the sleeve is vertically fixed on the lower surface of the cover plate; the elastic rod is inserted in the sleeve in a sliding manner; the spring is arranged between the elastic rod and the sleeve. The problem of air conditioner shell in the course of working, need carry out faster transportation to the shell to save time, if conventional transportation satisfies the speed requirement, then can't guarantee air conditioner shell stationarity is solved.

title: Clamping device for pressing and gold stamping of shell assembly
abstract: The utility model discloses a gilt clamping device that uses of casing subassembly pressfitting belongs to gilt device field. The utility model provides a shell subassembly pressfitting is gilt with clamping device, includes: the bottom plate, the electric push rod, the swing rod and the slide block; the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with a first fixed seat and a fixed frame; the electric push rod is fixedly provided with a rotating seat; the rotating seat and the fixed seat I are fixedly arranged; a second fixed seat is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate between the first fixed seat and the fixed frame; the second fixed seat is rotatably connected with the oscillating bar; the swing rod is connected with the sliding block in a sliding manner; a clamping ring is fixedly arranged at one end of the oscillating bar, which is far away from the sliding block; a spring is fixedly arranged between the sliding block and the clamping ring of the oscillating bar; compared with the prior art, the clamping device for the shell assembly pressing and gold stamping can clamp shells of different sizes, and can prevent workers from being scalded when the shells are taken.

title: Method and device for passively suppressing magnetic field noise of super-cooled atoms
abstract: A method and a device for passively suppressing magnetic field noise of super-cooled atoms, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step-down processing is carried out on the commercial electric signal by using a transformer to obtain a low-voltage sine wave signal; performing waveform conversion on the low-voltage sine wave signal by using a voltage comparator to obtain a low-voltage square wave signal; the low-voltage square wave signal is output in the forward direction or the reverse direction by utilizing a double-pole double-throw switch and a logic NOT gate, so that a clock signal is obtained; and triggering the gating signal through the D trigger chip based on the clock signal to obtain an output control signal. The device comprises a transformer, a switching power supply, a double-pole double-throw switch, a voltage comparator, a D trigger chip and a logic NOT gate. By using the method, the experiment is controlled by the square wave synchronous with the mains supply, the influence of noise generated by the mains supply is reduced, and the coherent time of the intra-atomic state control is increased by orders of magnitude. The application can be widely applied to the technical field of active noise reduction.

title: Signal output circuit and safety laser radar
abstract: The utility model provides a signal output circuit and a safe laser radar, wherein the signal output circuit comprises a level switching circuit, a first transistor detection circuit, a second transistor detection circuit and a controller, the level switching circuit comprises a first switch circuit and a second switch circuit, when the first switch circuit is conducted, a high-level control signal is output, when the second switch circuit is conducted, a low-level control signal is output, the first transistor detection circuit and the second transistor detection circuit respectively detect output currents when the first switch circuit and the second switch circuit are conducted, when the first level signal is output to the controller, the controller correspondingly switches the switch states of the first switch circuit or the second switch circuit, overcurrent detection and protection are realized, the working state of an external system is changed, meanwhile, the two transistor detection circuits are adopted, the structure is simple, the cost is low, the response time is short, and the overcurrent protection efficiency is improved.

title: High-speed signal transmission circuit and control method based on same
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a high-speed signal transmission circuit and a control method based on the high-speed signal transmission circuit, and relates to the field of printed circuits, wherein the high-speed signal transmission circuit comprises a sensing value compensation module, a capacitive adjustment module and a layer-changing through hole module; when the high-speed signal output by the layer-changing through hole module is received, the capacitive adjustment module is used for carrying out negative bias treatment on the working frequency of the high-speed signal, so that the high-speed signal is respectively subjected to frequency raising and frequency lowering through the inductance value compensation module and the capacitive adjustment module, and the electromagnetic interference shielding effect of frequency division of the high-speed signal is achieved through secondary fine adjustment of the working frequency of the high-speed signal; the extra design cost of the whole machine for the EMI is reduced, and the reliability of the product is improved.

title: module system
abstract: To provide a module system that prevents a signal that does not require real-time performance from interfering with a signal that requires real-time performance when communication with a higher-level control apparatus is passed through bus transmission paths between a master module and a slave module and between slave modules, an operation method of the module system, and an operation program readable to the module system.SOLUTION: In a module system, when a signal from a higher-level control apparatus is transmitted to a slave module via a master module, an appropriate bus transmission path is discriminated and selected according to contents of the signal, and the signal is transmitted and received in parallel with it.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Bias circuit and radio frequency power amplifier
abstract: The utility model discloses a bias circuit and a radio frequency power amplifier, which belong to the technical field of high-power lasers, wherein the bias circuit comprises a programmable digital-to-analog conversion module, an enabling signal end of the module is respectively connected with one end of a filter capacitor C 1 、C 2 and one end of a voltage stabilizing inductor L 1 , the other end of the filter capacitor C 1 、C 2 is grounded, an external enabling signal is connected with the external enabling signal through the other end of the voltage stabilizing inductor L 1 , and the external enabling signal is input to the programmable digital-to-analog conversion module after voltage stabilization and capacitance filtering, so that the output voltage of the module can be stabilized, the precision requirement of digital-to-analog conversion is ensured, the precision control of the required bias voltage is realized, and the stability and the precision of the bias voltage are further ensured. Meanwhile, when the power amplification chip changes, parameters of the programmable digital-to-analog conversion module can be flexibly adjusted. Based on the method, the complexity of the bias circuit can be reduced and the flexibility of the bias circuit can be improved on the premise of ensuring stability and accuracy.

title: MIMO mobile phone antenna self-adaptive tuning method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive tuning method of a MIMO mobile phone antenna based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of collecting working parameters, carrying out fusion coding on a working parameter set to generate a feature vector containing historical state and time sequence information, calculating an action range boundary according to the working parameter set, generating a boundary crossing detection rule and a rollback triggering condition, inputting the feature vector and the action range boundary into an improved diffusion policy generation model, generating tuning action by using a hierarchical policy network, detecting according to the boundary crossing detection rule and triggering rollback when crossing to obtain a stable execution state, calculating a stability index, constructing a diversity-stable collaborative rewarding function, updating the hierarchical policy network, generating a scene label, forming a key value pair index, storing, constructing a lightweight policy and solidifying in a network distillation mode. The invention realizes the self-adaptive tuning of the MIMO mobile phone antenna.

title: Mixed reality platform safety prompting method and system based on IOT equipment and early warning
abstract: The invention relates to a mixed reality platform safety prompting method and system based on IOT equipment and early warning, wherein the method comprises the following steps of classifying data transmission paths of the IOT equipment, matching communication protocols and acquiring control rights, and uploading acquired data information to a server; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-target deep learning early warning model, completing model training and testing based on high-voltage test scene historical data, forming an early warning algorithm, opening parameter setting permission, enabling a mixed reality platform to be connected with a server, embedding a parameter setting function of the early warning algorithm into the mixed reality platform, realizing that the mixed reality platform controls a safety threshold of an IOT device, visualizing server data through the mixed reality platform and carrying out safety auxiliary analysis, and triggering an automatic safety prompt when an MR device loaded with the mixed reality platform is subjected to high-voltage test, so that dangerous points are avoided. The invention has the advantages of equipment integration, data intercommunication, intelligent early warning accuracy improvement and the like.

title: Remote instruction response system and method for delivery robot
abstract: The invention discloses a remote instruction response system and method for a delivery robot, and relates to the technical field of Internet of things. The method comprises the following steps: the user side sends the control instruction to the user cloud server, the user cloud server records the control cloud server, and the control cloud server issues the control instruction to the robot; the robot records and observes the control command to perform response or interruption processing, uploads self state information to the data cloud server, the data cloud server stores the state information, sends the state information to the user cloud server at regular time, and renders the state information on the user terminal. The remote instruction response method provided by the invention adopts a duplex communication mechanism for communication, the control and feedback are mutually independent, the remote instruction response method has better response capability and network fault tolerance capability, and programs at all ends adopt an observation mode and a light memory mode, so that the remote instruction response method has better response capability to environmental data change, and the robot can timely respond to remote instructions in the distribution process.

title: Intelligent monitoring method for running state of power distribution network based on wireless communication network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of operation monitoring of power distribution networks, in particular to an intelligent monitoring method for the operation state of a power distribution network based on a wireless communication network. The cloud platform is used for generating a treatment plan package aiming at the identified high-risk target in advance and issuing the treatment plan package to the edge gateway, and when a fault occurs, the edge gateway can rapidly match and activate the treatment plans from a plurality of locally stored treatment plans without waiting for a cloud instruction, so that the improvement of fault response speed and the shortening of fault isolation and recovery time are realized, and the problem of slow response caused by communication delay in the prior art is effectively solved.

title: Wisdom commodity circulation perception device
abstract: The utility model discloses a wisdom commodity circulation perception device, including data interface, processing core, external device is connected with processing core through data interface, processing core includes drive layer, application layer and intermediate level, the drive layer is connected with data interface, the drive layer is connected with the application layer communication through the intermediate level; the application layer comprises WEB service, equipment configuration, firmware upgrading, data fusion and information push. The hardware interface of the utility model is standardized, and can be connected with various logistics sensing peripherals; the ultra-small hardware module can adapt to various product structures; standardizing a logistics perception algorithm; docking various algorithms; standardizing and flatting logistics service data of the external unified interface; and repeated development work is reduced.

title: Anti-aging wire and cable and preparation method thereof
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of wires and cables, and discloses an anti-aging wire and cable and a preparation method thereof; cobalt (Co) is selected as a metal blank, and bipyridine-imidazole connecting agent is introduced to prepare a two-dimensional MOF material with high heat dissipation performance and oxidation resistance; the preparation method comprises the steps of immersing carbon nano tubes in a MOF preparation process to prepare the composite MOF crosslinked carbon nano tubes with the three-dimensional structure, preparing two materials into a coating to be coated on the surface of a conductor, extruding a coating insulating layer through an extruder, cooling, rolling and packaging to obtain the anti-aging wire and cable. The material has wide application prospect in the field of wires and cables, and provides an effective way for solving the problem of cable aging.

title: Multifunctional catalyst, producing method thereof and use method thereof
abstract: To provide a multifunctional catalyst used for recycling polyester fabric, a producing method thereof, and a use method thereof.SOLUTION: A multifunctional catalyst 100 includes a carrier S, a first functional ionic liquid IL-1 and a second functional ionic liquid IL-2 grafted onto the carrier. The carrier is an inorganic composite powder material and is composed of a chemical component shown as C:Na-Ni/Al2O3. During recycling of polyester fabric, multifunctional catalysts can simultaneously decolorize and depolymerize polyester textiles. The first functional ionic liquid is used to decolorize the polyester fabric, and the second functional ionic liquid is used to depolymerize the polyester fabric.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Liquid metal/high polymer composite dielectric material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite materials, and particularly relates to a liquid metal/polymer composite dielectric material and a preparation method thereof. Uniformly blending the polymerization monomer solution, the liquid metal and the cross-linking agent to obtain a precursor solution; and standing the precursor solution to obtain the high-molecular dielectric material. The preparation method is simple and convenient, and the prepared composite material has excellent dielectric property and better tensile property than the traditional dielectric material, and has wide application prospect in the fields of wearable electronic equipment, soft robots and the like.

title: Preparation method of special nano calcium carbonate for polyester family degradable plastics
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of nano calcium carbonate special for polyester family degradable plastics, which adopts a zirconium alcohol compound as a crystal form control agent, so that the problem of high moisture absorption rate of the nano calcium carbonate caused by residual crystal control agent can be effectively avoided; the associative polyurethane thickener is added in the later stage of carbonation reaction, and the water-based thixotropic network constructed by polyurethane is used for replacing a hydrogen bond network on the surface of calcium carbonate, so that the aggregation phenomenon generated by crystals can be effectively reduced, and the phenomenon of high water content of nano calcium carbonate caused by the aggregation phenomenon is avoided; meanwhile, the invention adopts aprotic solvent to wash the filter cake for multiple times in the filter pressing process, so that a residual hydrogen bond network system of the nano calcium carbonate filter cake can be removed as much as possible, capillary pore effect caused by the filter cake drying process is reduced, the drying efficiency of the nano calcium carbonate finished product is further improved, and the technical effect that the nano calcium carbonate with the moisture content less than 0.1% can be produced in conventional drying equipment and preparation systems is realized.

title: High-performance granulation oil, preparation method thereof and method for producing rubber vulcanization accelerator particles
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of granulation oil, and particularly discloses high-performance granulation oil, a preparation method thereof and a method for producing rubber vulcanization accelerator particles. A process for preparing high-performance granulating oil includes such steps as mixing polyvinyl alcohol, emulsifier, defoaming agent and water to obtain basic liquid, 2) dissolving polyethanediol and cyclodextrin derivative in solvent, adding diisocyanate to perform the first-stage reaction, adding polybasic aldehyde to perform the second-stage reaction, washing, drying to obtain component A, mixing sodium tetraborate, polyose and quaternary phosphorus alkali, regulating pH value to be weak alkali, adding micro powder of rubber vulcanization accelerator, mixing to obtain component B, and mixing basic liquid, component A and component B. The high-performance granulation oil prepared by the application is used for producing rubber vulcanization accelerator particles, and has the advantages of good granulation effect, uniform particle size distribution and difficult powder falling.

title: Controlled release nutraceutical carrier and its manufacturing
abstract: A manufacturing process comprising vacuum assisted extraction coupled to ultrasound treatment of food by-products to obtain a controlled release agent comprising polysaccharides and polysaccharide bonded phenols is provided. A manufacturing process for food by-products comprising 3 cycles of vacuum instantaneous expansion, 15 minutes of ultrasound assisted extraction and pH of 1.5 to obtain polysaccharides with an increased range of antioxidant activity and a decreased zeta potential is also provided. A controlled release medicine comprising the controlled release agent obtained from the manufacturing processes is provided wherein the controlled release medicine comprises an active substance or beneficial microorganisms. The active agent may be selected from analgesics, antihistamines, digestives, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory agents, polyphenolic extracts, carotenoids, cannabinoids, and vitamins. The beneficial microorganism may be selected from Lactobacillus, Saccharomyces, Bifidobacterium, Streptococcus or Akkermansia. The bonded phenols may be gallic acid or polyphenols. The polysaccharide may be cellulose and hemicellulose. The food by-product is preferable persimmon (Diospyros kaki Thunb). [Fig: None]

title: Chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide particles and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide particles, which comprises the following steps: mixing Chlamydomonas reinhardtii with water to obtain a mixed solution; adding complex enzyme into the mixed solution, adding acetic acid to adjust pH, preserving heat, and heating for extraction to obtain an extract; filtering the extracting solution and concentrating the extracting solution into clear paste with the concentration of 1.05 to 1.15 g/mL; adding absolute ethyl alcohol into the clear paste, centrifugally separating and collecting precipitate; dissolving the precipitate in water, adding cyclodextrin, mixing, and spray drying to obtain polysaccharide dry powder; mixing the polysaccharide dry powder with starch and magnesium stearate, granulating, and sieving to obtain Chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide particles; the complex enzyme comprises cellulase, pectase and superoxide dismutase. According to the preparation method, the complex enzyme is adopted for enzymolysis, so that the cell wall structure of the chlamydomonas reinhardtii can be damaged to promote the polysaccharide to be easily dissolved out, the problems of low extraction efficiency and low purity in the chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide extraction process are solved, and the loss of the polysaccharide is avoided to the greatest extent.

title: Antibacterial, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant carex meyeriana extract, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an antibacterial, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant Meyer sedge extract, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of phytochemistry. Crushing the carex meyeriana, adding 50-95% ethanol with the volume and mass ratio of 8-12 times, soaking for 20-60 min, performing reflux extraction for 2 times, each time for 20-60 min, filtering, combining filtrates, concentrating, and drying to obtain the carex meyeriana. An application of Meyer sedge extract with antibacterial, antiinflammatory and antioxidant effects in preparing antibacterial, antiinflammatory or antioxidant agent is provided. The invention is an antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and wula sedge extract, which is derived from wula sedge of carex of cyperaceae and is an ethanol extract of the whole wula sedge, has good antibacterial, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, and has the following effects on gram-negative bacteria, gram-positive bacteria and typical pathogenic bacteria of fungi: staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Candida albicans, etc.

title: Method for promoting NEMANIA SP YAFEF112,112 to produce tea stain acid
abstract: The invention provides a method for promoting NEMANIA SP YAFEF112,112 to produce tea stain acid, and relates to the technical field of microbial culture. The method comprises the steps of inoculating NEMANIA SP YAFEF112,112 mycelia into a medium containing pruned branches of the nectarines for culturing, wherein the medium is MM medium, and specific formulas are 1.52: 1.52 g/L potassium dihydrogen phosphate, 0.52: 0.52 g/L magnesium sulfate, 6: 6 g/L sodium nitrate and 0.52: 0.52 g/L potassium chloride. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, and provides good conditions for the production of tea stain acid by optimizing the formula of a fermentation medium and adding walnut pruning branches into the medium, improving the fermentation conditions and increasing the content of the tea stain acid in NEMANIA SP YAFEF hyphae.

title: Method for producing compound oligosaccharide in sterilization process
abstract: The pyruvic acid catalyst adopted by the invention has two functional groups of carbonyl and carboxyl in the molecule, and has stronger catalytic activity. The gleditsia sinensis polysaccharide gum raw material is presoaked, so that the viscosity of an oligosaccharide production system of a subsequent sterilizing pot is greatly reduced, and the oligosaccharide conversion efficiency is improved. The camellia oleifera shell is subjected to hot water leaching pretreatment, so that the degradation reaction efficiency of hemicellulose of the camellia oleifera shell is improved while the effective components of the camellia oleifera saponin are recycled. The method has the advantages that the galactomannan and hemicellulose are catalytically degraded by the aqueous solution of the pyruvic acid at the sterilization temperature to efficiently produce the compound oligosaccharide, the pyruvic acid can be used as a functional additive in an oligosaccharide product, separation is not needed, the high-yield production of the compound oligosaccharide can be realized only by the sterilization operation of raw materials, and the production process is safe and efficient.

title: Transfer substrate, electronic device and manufacturing method of transfer substrate
abstract: To provide a transfer substrate capable of improving a yield, an electronic device and a manufacturing method of the transfer substrate.SOLUTION: A transfer substrate comprises: a substrate including a first top face; a conductive film which is provided on the substrate and includes a second top face; and a first insulator film which is provided on the substrate and directly in contact with the conductive film and includes a third top face continued to the second top face. The second top face and the third top face are tilted from the first top face in a boundary between the second top face and the third top face.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Apparatus and method for measuring modified area of substrate
abstract: To provide a substrate reforming area measuring device.SOLUTION: The imaging apparatus includes a first imaging device 101, a second imaging device 102, a third imaging device 103, and a microcomputer unit 104. The first imaging device faces the first surface of the substrate 110 and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a first image. The second imaging device faces the second surface of the substrate and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a second image. The first surface of the substrate is opposite to the second surface of the substrate. The third imaging device obliquely faces the first surface of the substrate or the second surface of the substrate, and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a third image. The micro-processor unit obtains a modified area measurement information of at least one modified area of the substrate according to the first image, the second image and the third image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Determination method, determination program, substrate processing device, and information processing device
abstract: To detect an occurrence of an embedding failure.SOLUTION: A determination method includes a step a) and a step b). In the step a), a pattern including a recessed part is formed, spectral measurement of a substrate in which an embedding material is embedded in the recessed part is performed, and either spectrum of an absorbance spectrum or a reflectance spectrum of the substrate is measured. In the step b), an embedded state of the recessed part is determined from an integration value of a spectrum value in each wavelength range of one spectrum of the substrate measured by the step a) by using a model generated by mechanically learning data obtained by associating the integration value of the spectrum value in each wavelength range about a plurality of wavelength ranges of the one spectrum of a plurality of substrates in which the embedding material is embedded with the embedded state of the recessed part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 14

title: Reflection board
abstract: To provide a reflection board which can reduce a manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: A reflection board 1 that reflects an electromagnetic wave of a specified frequency band to a direction different from a specular direction, includes an uneven structure in which a plurality of unit structures 10 including a thickness distribution where a thickness is increased to a predetermined direction is arranged. The unit structure 10 includes a plurality of cell regions 11a to 11f each having a different thickness, at least includes a first unit structure having two or more cell regions each having a different thickness as a unit structure, and includes a conductive layer 3 on a surface on each uneven structure side. Both of the adjacent cell regions are conducted.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Pattern manufacturing apparatus and pattern manufacturing method using the same
abstract: According to one embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for processing a pattern on a substrate may be provided. The apparatus for processing a pattern includes: a mold fixing part that fixes a mold at a position where the mold is in contact with the substrate to provide a pressing force to the substrate; a substrate transfer module that includes a linear actuator that moves the substrate in a straight line in one direction; and a rotation stage that rotates any one of the mold fixing part and the linear actuator to form the one direction and the mold at a predetermined rotation angle. Therefore, asymmetrically shaped patterns can be easily processed at high speed and low cost.

title: Detergent adding structure of central air conditioner cleaning device
abstract: The utility model discloses a structure is added to central air conditioning belt cleaning device's sanitizer, its structure includes liquid reserve tank and fluid infusion mechanism, inside the liquid reserve tank through having set up fluid infusion mechanism, carry out switching-over and measurement action to leading-in liquid through quadbit two-way valve and metering valve, and carry out the high-speed joint through first quick-operation joint and outside pipeline, be favorable to improving swift and accurate effect of feeding, filter and mix the action to clean liquid through fixed net ring and arc filter screen, through having set up rabbling mechanism at the liquid reserve tank top, drive the stirring rake and scrape the mixed effect of flitch to clean liquid through agitator motor and transmission shaft, through having set up heat transfer mechanism in the liquid reserve tank bottom, the water conservancy diversion effect through heat exchanger and inlet tube carries out the heat transfer action to clean mixed liquid, and lead to heat transfer rivers through the electromagnetic directional valve.

title: Sludge treatment device
abstract: The utility model discloses a sludge treatment device, which solves the problems that a cleaning device in the prior art cannot store sludge for a long time and cannot meet the detection requirement; the sludge conveying device comprises a box body, wherein an opening and closing door is hinged to the side wall of the box body, a sludge collecting funnel is arranged at the top end of the box body, a sludge blocking device for preventing sludge from splashing is arranged at the lower end of the sludge collecting funnel, and a filtering mechanism, a stirring mechanism and a conveying mechanism are sequentially arranged in the box body from top to bottom; the stirring mechanism comprises a stirring piece and a driving motor, the driving motor is fixedly installed on the outer side wall of the box body, the stirring piece is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the driving motor, the conveying mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the box body, and a discharge pipe is arranged on the side wall, close to the conveying direction of the conveying mechanism, of the bottom end of the box body. The sludge can be preserved for a long time, the freshness of the sludge is ensured, and the detection requirement is met; and meanwhile, the conveying efficiency of the sludge is improved.

title: Smoke removing device of holding furnace
abstract: The utility model discloses a smoke removing device of a heat preservation furnace, which comprises a heat preservation furnace main body, baffle plates, extrusion components, reset components, a spiral air supply pipe, a unidirectional circulation mechanism, an air supply pipe, a mounting shell, an air outlet pipe, an air inlet pipe and an elastic diaphragm, wherein the mounting shell is arranged above the outer part of the heat preservation furnace main body, the air outlet pipe and the air inlet pipe are respectively arranged above and below the outer part of the mounting shell, the baffle plates are arranged on two sides of the inner part of the mounting shell, mounting frames are arranged on two sides between the baffle plates, the elastic diaphragm is arranged in the mounting frames, the extrusion components are arranged between the elastic diaphragm and the mounting shell, the reset components are arranged between the elastic diaphragm and the baffle plates, and the spiral air supply pipe is arranged on the rear side of the outer part of the heat preservation furnace main body. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the unidirectional property and the continuous stability of the flue gas transportation are ensured, the flue gas is cooled as much as possible before the flue gas is scrubbed, and the evaporation of liquid in the gas scrubbing bottle is reduced.

title: Waste gas purifying device of cleaning agent production line
abstract: The utility model discloses an exhaust gas purification device of a cleaning agent production line, which comprises a purification box and a box door arranged on the purification box, wherein a control panel and a handle rod are arranged on the outer wall of the box door, an exhaust fan is arranged at the top of the purification box, a water collecting box is arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the purification box, a spray head driven by a driving component is arranged in the purification box, a pump is fixed on the inner wall of the purification box, the water inlet end of the pump penetrates through the purification box, the pump is connected with the spray head through a water pipe, a stirring mechanism connected with the driving component is arranged in the purification box, a drain pipe is arranged on the outer wall of the water collecting box, the driving component comprises a threaded screw rod rotatably arranged in the purification box, and a bidirectional motor with an output shaft coaxially fixed with the threaded screw rod is fixed on the outer wall of the purification box. The utility model combines the sprayed water body and the mixed and stirred water body to perform better adsorption effect on the soluble smell in the cleaning agent.

title: Sodium metasilicate cooling water circulator
abstract: The utility model discloses a sodium metasilicate cooling water circulator, include the header tank, install in inlet tube and the outlet pipe of the relative both sides surface of header tank, the top fixed mounting of header tank has the roof, the top demountable installation of header tank has the apron, two liang of a set of symmetry fixed mounting respectively of the relative both sides internal surface that the header tank is close to the outlet pipe has four limiting plates, and is two sets of insert between the limiting plate and be equipped with the filter, the inside packing of filter has active carbon, the filter is hollow structure, install rabbling mechanism between the diapire of roof and header tank. The utility model discloses a filter that sets up in the header tank filters and adsorbs the cooling water of discharge outlet pipe, gets rid of the impurity in the cooling water, when preventing to use for a long time, the pipeline is stopped up to the impurity in the cooling water, influences the unblocked nature that the cooling water flowed.

title: Noise reduction parameter setting method and device, earphone equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a noise reduction parameter setting method, a device, earphone equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the earphone equipment acquires an environment signal picked up by a feedforward microphone and a noise signal picked up by a feedback microphone; calculating an energy difference between the ambient signal and the noise signal; and acquiring a target noise reduction parameter value corresponding to the energy difference value, and setting noise reduction parameters of an active noise reduction mode in the earphone equipment according to the target noise reduction parameter value. According to the invention, even if the coupling state of the earphone equipment and the auditory canal of the user is different due to the difference of wearing habits of the user and the difference of the auditory canal, the expected active noise reduction effect can be achieved through the corresponding noise reduction parameter value, and the experience of the user using the active noise reduction function of the earphone is improved.

title: Infrared array annular sensing device based on FPC
abstract: The application discloses an infrared array annular sensing device based on an FPC (flexible printed circuit), which relates to the technical field of sensors and comprises a flexible transmitting plate, a flexible receiving plate and an installation circular ring; the flexible transmitting board is provided with a transmitting circuit, and the flexible receiving board is provided with a receiving circuit; the flexible transmitting plates and the flexible receiving plates are distributed on the inner annular wall of the mounting circular ring at equal intervals in an annular mode, and transmitting circuits on the flexible transmitting plates and receiving circuits on the flexible receiving plates are arranged at intervals; the transmitting circuit and the receiving circuit are respectively and electrically connected with the detection main board circuit; the flexible transmitting board and the transmitting circuit thereon form a transmitting FPC, and the flexible receiving board and the receiving circuit thereon form a receiving FPC. By adopting the application, under the use requirements corresponding to the mounting rings with different diameters, the FPC with corresponding length is cut off and sleeved in the mounting ring, so that the universality of the product is improved.

title: Industrial truck having a fork and a fork arm camera and method for operating such an industrial truck
abstract: An industrial truck ( 2 ) and a method for operating an industrial truck ( 2 ). The industrial truck ( 2 ) includes an assistance system and a fork ( 4 ) having at least two fork arms ( 61, 62 ). The assistance system includes at least one fork arm camera ( 8, 8 ′), a monitor, and a processing unit ( 10 ). The fork arm camera ( 8, 8 ′) is disposed on the fork ( 4 ) such that at least part of a tip ( 71, 72 ) of at least one of the two fork arms ( 61, 62 ) is present in the field of view of the fork arm camera ( 8, 8 ′). The processing unit ( 10 ) is set up for capturing at least one tip ( 71, 72 ) of the at least one fork arm ( 61, 62 ) in the image data, for calculating at least one marking ( 18 ) indicating the position of the fork ( 4 ), and for reproducing on the monitor the image data captured by the fork arm camera ( 8, 8 ′) and superimposed with the marking ( 18 ).

title: Rotary plate valve for pipeline
abstract: The utility model provides a rotation type plate valve for pipeline, include the valve main part that links to each other with the outside pipeline, drive assembly and fixed knot construct, the inside closing plate that is equipped with of valve main part, drive assembly includes the actuating lever, the transfer line, torsion spring and rotatory handle, the actuating lever is connected with the closing plate, the transfer line is connected with the actuating lever transmission, rotatory handle is connected with torsion spring and with transfer line fixed connection, torsion spring has power storage state and initial state, pivoted rotatory handle drives the transfer line and rotates, then drive the actuating lever and rotate, make the actuating lever drive the closing plate and rotate in order to realize the switching of valve main part, and, pivoted rotatory handle drives torsion spring and switches between power storage state and initial state, the torsion spring correspondence of power storage state is in the valve main part of opening, fixed knot constructs and is used for being fixed in torsion spring and holds the power state. The valve can be closed more easily by the stored state of the torsion spring.

title: Pomegranate wine production equipment and process capable of preventing inner cores from being broken
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of pomegranate wine production, and provides a pomegranate wine production device and a process for preventing kernel from being broken, wherein the pomegranate wine production device for preventing kernel from being broken comprises a device box for producing fragrant pomegranate wine, and a conveying box is arranged on the device box and is used for conveying pomegranate seeds for producing the fragrant pomegranate wine; the device comprises a conveying box, a hopper, a squeezing cylinder, a primary filter box and a device box, wherein the hopper is fixedly communicated with the top of the conveying box, the squeezing cylinder is fixedly communicated with the discharge end of the conveying box and used for squeezing and treating the pomegranate seeds, and the primary filter box is arranged in the device box and used for receiving and treating the squeezed juice of the pomegranate seeds and an inner core. The technical problem that the quality of the pomegranate wine is reduced due to the broken inner core in the current production process of the pomegranate wine is solved.
